description: Web search and web fetch for every agent in bb, as bb's own tools. The model in a pi, Codex, Claude Code or ACP thread can search the web and read a page, and each call is a real timeline row with an icon, a label and a duration instead of a raw tool call. Keyless DuckDuckGo and Exa out of the box, Brave or SearXNG when you add a key, batch queries, recency and domain filters, readable markdown, GitHub-aware fetching, paging and passage search.
